label: The Field
description: What the armies stand on — terrain as material, its weather-state, and the distance it opens toward the horizon.

items.name: churned-mud
items.text: a field churned to shin-deep mud, wheel-ruts holding ribbons of reflected sky, lost horseshoes and split shield-boards half-swallowed, every footprint filling with water

items.name: trampled-wheat
items.text: a ripe wheatfield flattened in great swathes where the lines passed, standing gold surviving only at the margins, loose chaff blowing across the ruts

items.name: frost-moor
items.text: an iron-hard frosted moor, heather rimed white, black peat showing through wherever boots have scuffed it, the far ridge knife-sharp in scoured air

items.name: river-ford
items.text: a wide gravel ford churned milky, shin-deep current dragging at the banners' reflections, the far bank rising in trampled terraces

items.name: cinder-plain
items.text: a cinder plain still warm underfoot, ground cracked into slabs with a dull orange glow seeping through the seams, dead trees standing as black posts to the horizon

items.name: trampled-snow
items.text: a snowfield churned grey-brown along the lines of advance, drifts still clean in the hollows, spent arrows peppering the white like punctuation

items.name: barrow-downs
items.text: grass downland studded with burial barrows and leaning standing stones, the armies flowing around the old mounds as if by unspoken agreement

items.name: marsh-causeway
items.text: a single timber causeway across black marsh water, reeds bowing in the wind, room for six abreast and no more, the bog mirroring every banner

items.name: chalk-scarp
items.text: a chalk escarpment scarred white where hooves cut through the thin turf, long slopes funneling both lines together toward the valley floor

items.name: palisade-ground
items.text: the open ground before a burned palisade, blackened stakes leaning outward, smoke still crawling low along the plough furrows
